about: Worked out with WoWSims Forever's own Stat Weights tool (wowsims.com/forever/warlock/dps, game 1.60.1.70938, site built 2026-11-17 from commit ad6b13a), since its warlock sim ships no weights. Its Demo (Fire Brand) preset (talents 2/31/18, rotation, buffs) on that build's own gear set (ui/specs/warlock/dps/gear_sets/demo_fire_brand.gear.json, as the preset loads it), 12,500 iterations, reference stat Spell Damage. DPS EP as the tool shows it; '1%' rows are per 1%. Run in the app's browser on 17 Nov 2026 (US Central). Before it (14 Nov, on preraid.gear.json): Stamina 0.0, Intellect 0.27, Spell Damage 1.0, Fire Spell Damage 0.75, Shadow Spell Damage 0.25, Spell Piercing 1.08, Spirit 0.12, 1% Hit 11.95, 1% Crit 7.16, 1% Haste 4.22, MP5 0.23.
